parentNote.en: Every question is answered in the app. Each goal has a short home activity: say the words aloud together, and let your child guess first.
parentNote.ar: كل الأسئلة الطفل بيحلها جوه البرنامج، ولكل هدف نشاط قصير في البيت. قولوا الكلمات بصوت عالي مع بعض، وسيبوا طفلك يتوقع الأول.

steps.title: Rhyme time
steps.prompt: Tap each pair to listen. Do they finish the same?
steps.explanation: Rhyming words end with the same sound: one and sun, three and tree.
steps.shortExplanation: Rhyming words end with the same sound: one and sun, three and tree.

steps.title: Listen with your ears

options.label: Rhymes are for the ears, not the eyes. One and sun rhyme, even though they look different.
Cat and cup start the same, but they do not finish the same. They do not rhyme.
We can clap the beat of a rhyme, like a drum.

steps.explanation: Rhymes are for the ears: say the words aloud and listen to the end.
steps.shortExplanation: Rhymes are for the ears: say the words aloud and listen to the end.

steps.title: Number name: 3
steps.hint: Say it slowly: th-r-ee. It rhymes with tree.
steps.explanation: Three is t, h, r, e, e. It rhymes with tree.
steps.shortExplanation: Three is t, h, r, e, e. It rhymes with tree.

steps.title: Number name: 8
steps.hint: Eight is a tricky word. It starts with e-i-g.
steps.explanation: Eight is e, i, g, h, t. It rhymes with gate but looks different.
steps.shortExplanation: Eight is e, i, g, h, t. It rhymes with gate but looks different.

steps.title: Which does not rhyme?
steps.prompt: Three, tree, them, sea. Which one does not rhyme?
steps.hint: Say each word and listen to the end: ee, ee…
steps.explanation: Three, tree and sea end with ee. Them does not rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Three, tree and sea end with ee. Them does not rhyme.

source.answerKeyText: a them • b socks • c night

steps.title: Which does not rhyme?
steps.prompt: Six, sticks, socks, mix. Which one does not rhyme?
steps.hint: Listen for the ix sound at the end.
steps.explanation: Six, sticks and mix end with ix. Socks ends with ocks.
steps.shortExplanation: Six, sticks and mix end with ix. Socks ends with ocks.

source.answerKeyText: a them • b socks • c night

steps.title: Which does not rhyme?
steps.prompt: Nine, fine, night, sign. Which one does not rhyme?
steps.hint: Listen for the ine sound at the end.
steps.explanation: Nine, fine and sign end with ine. Night ends with t.
steps.shortExplanation: Nine, fine and sign end with ine. Night ends with t.

source.answerKeyText: a them • b socks • c night

steps.title: Rhyming pairs
steps.prompt: Match each word to the word that rhymes with it.
steps.hint: Say both words aloud. Do your ears hear the same ending?
steps.explanation: Cat and hat, sun and one, bee and tree, hen and ten end the same.
steps.shortExplanation: Cat and hat, sun and one, bee and tree, hen and ten end the same.

source.answerKeyText: cat – hat • sun – one • bee – tree • hen – ten

steps.title: The alphabet
steps.prompt: Which letter is missing? a, b, …, d, e
steps.hint: Sing the alphabet song up to d.
steps.explanation: The alphabet goes a, b, c, d, e. The missing letter is c.
steps.shortExplanation: The alphabet goes a, b, c, d, e. The missing letter is c.

source.answerKeyText: c, f, i, l, p, t, y

steps.title: The alphabet
steps.prompt: Which letter is missing? o, …, q, r, s
steps.hint: Sing the alphabet from n: n, o…
steps.explanation: The alphabet goes o, p, q, r, s. The missing letter is p.
steps.shortExplanation: The alphabet goes o, p, q, r, s. The missing letter is p.

source.answerKeyText: c, f, i, l, p, t, y

steps.title: Letters that work together
steps.hint: Look at the picture and say the whole word: ship, tree, star, green.
steps.explanation: Ship starts with sh, tree with tr, star with st and green with gr.
steps.shortExplanation: Ship starts with sh, tree with tr, star with st and green with gr.

steps.title: Noun or verb?
steps.prompt: The kite flies. The dog runs. The bird sings. Is each word a noun or a verb?
steps.hint: What is it? A noun. What does it do? A verb.
steps.explanation: Kite, dog and bird are nouns. Flies, runs and sings are verbs.
steps.shortExplanation: Kite, dog and bird are nouns. Flies, runs and sings are verbs.

source.answerKeyText: Nouns: kite, dog, bird • Verbs: flies, runs, sings

steps.title: Capital letters and a full stop
steps.prompt: Which sentence is written the right way?

options.label: Yesterday ali and I flew a kite.
Yesterday Ali and I flew a kite.
yesterday Ali and i flew a kite.

steps.hint: Check the first word, the name Ali, the word I and the end.
steps.explanation: Yesterday, Ali and I start with capitals, and it ends with a full stop.
steps.shortExplanation: Yesterday, Ali and I start with capitals, and it ends with a full stop.

source.answerKeyText: Yesterday Ali and I flew a kite.

steps.title: A describing word
steps.prompt: The silver moon. Which word tells us what the moon is like?
steps.explanation: Silver is a describing word. It tells us what the moon is like.
steps.shortExplanation: Silver is a describing word. It tells us what the moon is like.

source.answerKeyText: Any of the words, one in each space — for example: The silver moon. The twinkling stars. The sleepy child.

steps.title: Rhymes with cat
steps.hint: Cat ends with at. Which one ends the same?
steps.explanation: Cat and hat both end with at, so they rhyme.
steps.shortExplanation: Cat and hat both end with at, so they rhyme.

steps.title: What makes a rhyme?
steps.hint: Think of cat and hat. Where are they the same?
steps.explanation: Rhyming words have the same sound at the end, like cat and hat.
steps.shortExplanation: Rhyming words have the same sound at the end, like cat and hat.

steps.title: The alphabet
steps.prompt: How many letters are in the English alphabet?
steps.hint: Sing the alphabet song and count on your fingers.
steps.explanation: The English alphabet has 26 letters, from a to z. Arabic has 28.
steps.shortExplanation: The English alphabet has 26 letters, from a to z. Arabic has 28.

steps.title: Find the verb
steps.prompt: The kite zooms up in the sky. Which word is the verb?
steps.explanation: Zooms is the doing word. Kite and sky are nouns.
steps.shortExplanation: Zooms is the doing word. Kite and sky are nouns.

englishVisual.text: The kite zooms up in the sky.

steps.title: Spell 8
steps.prompt: Which number name is spelled correctly?
steps.hint: Eight is a tricky word: e-i-g-h-t.
steps.explanation: Eight is spelled e, i, g, h, t.
steps.shortExplanation: Eight is spelled e, i, g, h, t.

stickers.meaning: Words that end with the same sound: cat, hat.

goalActivities.text: Hide the number names one to ten under cups with that many beans. Your child reads each word and counts the beans to check.
goalActivities.textAr: خبّوا أسامي الأرقام من one لـ ten تحت كبايات، وتحت كل كباية عدد فول زي الرقم. طفلك يقرا الكلمة ويعدّ الفول عشان يتأكد.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say three rhyming words and one that does not. Your child claps for the odd one out. Then swap.
goalActivities.textAr: قول تلات كلمات على نفس القافية وواحدة لأ، وطفلك يصقف للكلمة اللي مش زيهم. وبعدين بدّلوا.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Draw four pictures, like a cat, the sun, a bee and a hen. Your child says a word that rhymes with each one.
goalActivities.textAr: ارسموا أربع صور زي قطة وشمس ونحلة وفرخة، وطفلك يقول كلمة على نفس القافية لكل واحدة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Pour a thin layer of salt on a tray. Say a letter; your child writes it with a finger, starting at the top. Shake to erase.
goalActivities.textAr: حطوا طبقة رفيعة ملح على صينية. قول حرف، وطفلك يكتبه بصباعه ويبدأ من فوق. هزّوا الصينية عشان تتمسح.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Go on a hunt for sh, tr, st and gr words at home: shoe, tray, stairs, grapes. Say each one slowly.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا في البيت على كلمات فيها sh و tr و st و gr: shoe و tray و stairs و grapes. قولوا كل كلمة ببطء.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say a short sentence like "The cat sleeps." Your child points to the thing (noun) and acts out the doing word (verb).
goalActivities.textAr: قول جملة قصيرة زي "The cat sleeps."، وطفلك يشاور على الحاجة (noun) ويمثّل الفعل (verb).
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Write a sentence with your child's name and the word I in it, all in small letters. Your child fixes the capitals.
goalActivities.textAr: اكتب جملة فيها اسم طفلك وكلمة I، كلها بحروف صغيرة، وطفلك يصلّح الحروف الكبيرة.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: At bedtime, look out of the window and describe what you see: the silver moon, the twinkling stars, the sleepy cat.
goalActivities.textAr: وقت النوم بصّوا من الشباك واوصفوا اللي شايفينه: the silver moon و the twinkling stars و the sleepy cat.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Find things at home that rhyme with cat: a hat, a mat, a bat. Say each pair aloud.
goalActivities.textAr: دوّروا على حاجات في البيت على قافية cat: hat و mat و bat. وقولوا كل اتنين بصوت عالي.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Say two words and ask: do they start the same or finish the same? Cat and cup start the same; cat and hat rhyme.
goalActivities.textAr: قول كلمتين واسأل: بيبدأوا زي بعض ولا بيخلصوا زي بعض؟ cat و cup بيبدأوا زي بعض، و cat و hat على نفس القافية.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Sing the alphabet song together while you point to the letters on a poster or in a book.
goalActivities.textAr: غنّوا أغنية الحروف مع بعض وانتو بتشاوروا على الحروف في بوستر أو كتاب.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Fly a paper kite or a plastic bag on a string. Your child says what it does: it zooms, it flies, it falls.
goalActivities.textAr: طيّروا طيارة ورق أو كيس بلاستيك في خيط، وطفلك يقول بيعمل إيه: it zooms و it flies و it falls.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

goalActivities.text: Practise tricky number words with Look, Say, Cover, Write, Check: look at eight, say it, cover it, write it, then check.
goalActivities.textAr: اتمرنوا على كلمات الأرقام الصعبة بطريقة Look, Say, Cover, Write, Check: بص على eight، قولها، غطّيها، اكتبها، واتأكد.
goalActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
goalActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.

homeActivities.text: Play rhyme tennis in the car: you say a word, your child hits back a word that rhymes. Made-up words count too.
homeActivities.textAr: العبوا تنس القوافي في العربية: تقول كلمة، وطفلك يرد بكلمة على نفس القافية. والكلمات المتألفة كمان تنفع.
homeActivities.safety: An adult supervises. An adult does any cutting: cut plastic has sharp edges, so cover them with tape.
homeActivities.safetyAr: لازم شخص كبير يكون موجود. الكبير هو اللي يقص: البلاستيك المقصوص حروفه حادة، فغطّوها بشريط لاصق.
